what: The small case-photo bundle beside the big name-row list (side panel) follows the mouse height by .1 per frame (.1s power2.out, stops within the list) as it comes down. Hovering a row opens that row’s photo with a clip over .35s power2.out from the side it entered (the nearer of top-center or bottom-center of the row). The previously open photo closes toward the opposite side over .35s, and leaving the row closes it toward the exit side over .6s.

options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo bundle panel (required) — default top right, width is --fx-width (default 210px)
options.[data-fx-part=card]: One per row, photos in the same order (required) — reuse them if short
options.open · close: Open · close-on-leave duration in seconds, default .35 · .6
options.lerp: Share followed per frame along mouse height, default .1

note: On touch screens the photo group is hidden and nothing is attached (the original switches on narrow screens to a different list with a small photo on each row).
